_comment: Logitech force-feedback wheel + pedals bindings for ev1sim. Pass via --config (other settings fall back to defaults), or copy the input.wheel / input.ffb blocks into your own config. Axis indices and pedal in_min/in_max are device-specific — verify with your wheel (a pedal that rests high floors low, so in_min > in_max inverts it). Button indices are best-effort defaults; remap to taste. Actions are the names in src/InputActions.h.

rig._comment: Button boxes on a driving rig, each matched by a substring of its SDL name. buttons: momentary, any action name from src/InputActions.h. switches: a contact whose level sets an input; names in src/RigSwitches.h (seatbelt_driver, charge_coupler, hvac_ac, hvac_defrost, window_*_up/down, hvac_fan_*, hvac_mode_*); invert for a normally-closed contact. Example device: { "device_name_match": "Button Box", "buttons": [ { "sdl_button": 0, "action": "hazard_toggle" } ], "switches": [ { "sdl_button": 1, "switch": "seatbelt_driver" } ] }
